scoreRationale: The rural locality has one exceptional standalone attraction but not an independently worthwhile settlement-level visitor experience.

namedTrailSearch.TreasureTrails: The live Dundee and Angus catalogue has no Eassie product.
retained: Angus Pictish Trail – Eassie Church stop

practicalAudit.eat: No café, coffee-and-cake outlet, tearoom, bakery or light-lunch venue was verified inside the strict boundary.
practicalAudit.picnic: No managed public picnic facility was published for the site.
practicalAudit.parking: HES publishes directions via the old church west of Glamis but does not publish a dedicated visitor car park, capacity, stay limit or payment information; no parking pin is created.
practicalAudit.toilets: No on-site toilet is published by HES and no local public toilet was verified.
practicalAudit.accessibility: The official page does not publish a detailed accessibility statement for this site; visitors should check current conditions directly.
practicalAudit.transport: HES links to public-transport and cycle journey planners but does not publish a dedicated stop at the site.

exclusions: Nearby Glamis and Meigle cafés and facilities are outside Eassie and are not borrowed.
Private farm access is not presented as public parking.
The Pictish stone is scored under See, not transferred into the settlement score.
